generator_metadata.summary: For each solid gray(5) rectangle, read the four distinct colored markers one cell diagonally outside its bounding-box corners. Erase those markers and fill the rectangle's four local quadrants with the top-left, top-right, bottom-left, and bottom-right marker colors. Process every rectangle independently; for odd dimensions the extra row or column belongs to the bottom or right half.

The canonical rule uses each rectangle’s local marker palette. The alternate first selects the unique largest gray rectangle by area, reads its TL/TR/BL/BR marker colors, and routes that palette to every rectangle. The grammar deliberately makes the first rectangle a larger-perimeter decoy, so the sequential selector is not reducible to position or perimeter. Four private queries include an exact 30×30 substantive case.
